card.name: Partway through long uncommon words
card.fires_on: Fires on a middle piece of a longer or rarer word, such as the 'num' in magnum, 'rog' in macroglossia, 'eth' in Paramethasone and 'et' in Technetium. Also fires after 'non' in words like non-gonadal.

modes.label: Inside rare words
modes.description: A middle piece of a long, uncommon word or drug name.

modes.label: After non
modes.description: The piece right after the prefix 'non' that starts the next word.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long, unusual words as the model is still spelling them out.
